notes: Temporary diagnostic, not normal-release acceptance. Apply sender-controller-diagnostic.patch then sender-loss-scan-diagnostic.patch to 13cdebd. Startup clock fix is absent.
Fixed loss-scan counters add no allocations or syscalls; existing controller diagnostics add clock reads and immediate/1Hz monitor snapshots. No builds/tests overlap load.

Loss scan reads count each primary bitmap access, including repeated accesses to the same word for successive live packets. Empty counts cursor-masked words with no outstanding bit. Span is retained packet-number span at scan creation, not work.
Continuations count scan chunks that exhaust their allowance while incomplete. Starts/completed include zero-inflight fast paths.
Directions L->R/R->L; endpoint arrays L/R. Receiver sample goodput excludes drain; missing ratios include drain. 100% CPU is one CPU.
TAP SKBs, queue drops and expired frames use different units and cannot be added into an exact frame-loss total.
These counters establish redundant scan work, not its isolated throughput cost or a CPU ceiling. Both performance gates remain unmet.
